intro: Scan the server disk, then remove what is useless: temporary files, caches, old logs and old local backups. The scan removes nothing; you then choose what to clean.
noScanYet: No scan yet: run one to see what can be freed.

app-temp.title: Application working files
app-temp.description: In-progress copies and encryptions left for more than 2 h in data/backups/_tmp-* (Drive upload, USB, encryption).

tmp-owned.title: Temporary files
tmp-owned.description: The service account's files in /tmp and /var/tmp, neither modified nor read for more than 7 days. Other accounts' files are never touched.

npm-cache.title: npm cache
npm-cache.description: npm download cache of the service account. It rebuilds itself on the next build (auto-update).

docker-dangling-images.title: Orphaned Docker images
docker-dangling-images.description: Untagged ("dangling") images no container uses: leftovers of rebuilds. Tagged images are not touched.

docker-build-cache.title: Docker build cache
docker-build-cache.description: Unused Docker build cache. It rebuilds on the next image build.

apt-cache.title: Downloaded packages (apt)
apt-cache.description: .deb files already installed, kept in /var/cache/apt. apt downloads them again if needed.

journal.title: Old system logs
journal.description: systemd journal: keeps the last 14 days and removes the rest. May erase old logs you would need for a diagnosis.

old-backups.title: Old local backups
old-backups.description: Local backups older than {{days}} days. The {{keep}} newest of each source are always kept, and copies on USB and Google Drive are not touched.

scanErrors.journal_unreadable: Size unreadable: the journal sudo rule is missing. Re-run deploy/install.sh on this server.

confirm.title: Clean {{count}} categor(ies)?
confirm.description: About {{size}} will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
confirm.reviewWarning: The selection includes items to review (old backups or logs): they cannot be recovered.

localBackups.title: Where local backup space goes
localBackups.description: Size of each data/backups folder. Copies outside this server (USB, Google Drive) are not counted.

neverTouched: Never touched by this screen: installed packages, kernels, Docker volumes, stopped containers, databases and recent backups.
